comparison.objective: Move a tissue-roll stub to the reserve spindle, install a new primary roll, set the changeover shutter, and close the dispenser.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold release buttons while extracting and seating large cores, then manipulate a shutter and sprung cover.
comparison.success_condition: Credit requires correctly engaged rolls in their assigned hubs, a latched cover, correct shutter position, and released hands; misassignment and unsafe closure fail.
comparison.reason: This tests release-controlled core transfer and dispenser sequencing, not preserving an adjustable screw setting against jam-nut reaction or validating repeated motion.
